chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Hadeed, from Murazam who said:

I, along with Ammar and a group, entered upon Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) in Medina. He asked, 'What is your stay?' Ammar replied, 'We have released our backs (set out on journey) and we have been given leave for fifteen days.' He said, 'You have attained the stay in the city of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and the prayer in his mosque. Work for your Hereafter and be abundant for yourselves. Indeed, a man may be clever in the world, and it will be said, 'How clever is so-and-so!', but the truly clever one is the one who is clever regarding the Hereafter.'

key_terms.بَلَدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: City of the Messenger of Allah (Medina)
key_terms.سَرَّحْنَا ظَهْرَنَا: We released our backs (idiom for setting out on a journey)

ai.seo_question: What is the definition of true cleverness (kays) in Shia Islam according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) validates the spiritual merit of staying in Medina, linking the physical presence in the Prophet's city with the performance of prayers and seclusion (*I'tikaf*) in his mosque. He elevates this practice by redefining *al-kays* (cleverness/prudence), teaching that true wisdom is measured not by worldly acumen but by one's strategic preparation for the Hereafter, a core concept in Shia ethical theology.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Hadeed, from Murazam who said,

‘I, and Ammar, and a group went over to Abu Abdullahasws in Al-Medina. So heasws said: ‘What is your stay?’ So Ammar said, ‘We have released our backs, and we instructed that we would be going with it for fifteen days’. So heasws said: ‘You have attained the place in a city of Rasool-Allahsaww, and the praying of the Salaat in hissaww Masjid; and you should be working for your Hereafter, and frequent for yourselves. The man would happen to be clever regarding the world, so it would be said, ‘How clever is so and so!’, and rather, the clever is the one who is clever regarding the Hereafter’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ali ibn Hadid from Murazim who has said the following:

“Once ‘Ammar, a group and I went to visit abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, in al-Madinah and he asked, ‘For how long have you decided to stay in al-Madinah?’ ‘Ammar said, ‘We have sent our camels to pasture for fifteen days.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘Your decision to stay in the town of the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, and performing salat (prayer) in the Masjid is a proper one. You should work for your next life for yourselves a great deal. A man can be very intelligent in the worldly matters and people say, “How intelligent he is!” In fact, a true intelligent person is one who is intelligent in matters of the next life.’”
